searchText: Does anyone here know how to create a shadow fork that includes the beacon chain? (Not just an execution level fork like with foundry/hardhat/etc., but also somehow a way to run beacon and validator APIs on the fork) The ability is built into kurtosis, have a look at the docs for an example 🙂 are you talking about <https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package>? from what I could tell, that creates a fresh chain not a fork I see it has a shadowforking section though, maybe that's it Yeah exactly, the tool can be used to sync known testnets and create shadowforks too. It'll pull the state from an s3 bucket and then perform a shadowfork. There are some gotchas, but it should mostly work. We use it for verkle transition tests for e.g. seems like it doesn't work though: `Evaluation error: key "holesky-shadowfork" not in dict` should I be expecting holesky to be available for shadowfork? (I got that from the readme). doesn't work with `mainnet-shadowfork` either looks like that error is coming when it tries to find the volume sizes and indeed "holesky-shadowfork" isn't one with specified sizes. but i guess it shouldn't have got that far with a shadowfork.. Are you trying to run it locally or against a kubernetes cluster? switch to DM to avoid spamming here?

excerpts.author: xrchz
excerpts.content: I see it has a shadowforking section though, maybe that's it

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Yeah exactly, the tool can be used to sync known testnets and create shadowforks too.

It'll pull the state from an s3 bucket and then perform a shadowfork. There are some gotchas, but it should mostly work. We use it for verkle transition tests for e.g.
